gbifID.description: Unique identifier for each species occurrence record in the dataset.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier for the dataset containing Rusa timorensis occurrence records.

occurrenceID.description: Unique identifiers for species occurrence records from iNaturalist observations.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic classification of the species, consistently recorded as Animalia.

phylum.description: Taxonomic classification at the phylum level for Rusa timorensis occurrence records.

class.description: Taxonomic class of observed species, uniformly recorded as Mammalia.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently recorded as Artiodactyla.

family.description: Taxonomic family classification of Rusa timorensis, consistently recorded as Cervidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus name of the species, consistently recorded as Rusa.

species.description: Species name of observed individuals, consistently recorded as Rusa timorensis.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific taxon name, entirely missing in dataset.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the observed species, consistently recorded as SPECIES.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed species, standardized as Rusa timorensis (Blainville, 1822).

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of observed species, consistently recorded as Rusa timorensis.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship details for Rusa timorensis records.

countryCode.description: Country codes identifying observation locations, primarily Indonesia (ID), Australia (AU), and others.

locality.description: Locality description for Rusa timorensis occurrence records, entirely missing.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region where Rusa timorensis occurrences were recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Species occurrence status, always recorded as PRESENT.

individualCount.description: Individual count of Rusa timorensis observations, all records missing.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the publishing organization of the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude in degrees, ranging from -36.79 to 4.38.

decimalLongitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, ranging from -50.14 to 166.83.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty of species occurrence records in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy in meters, all values missing.

depth.description: Depth data missing for all Rusa timorensis occurrence records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy measurement for species occurrence records, entirely missing.

eventDate.description: Date and time of species occurrence records, formatted as ISO 8601 timestamps.

day.description: Day of the month for species occurrence records, ranging 1-31.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from 1 to 12.

year.description: Year of species occurrence records, ranging from 1986 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Rusa timorensis species occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique identifier for Rusa timorensis species in biodiversity records.

basisOfRecord.description: Observation method type for species occurrence records.

institutionCode.description: Institution identifier for the data provider, exclusively iNaturalist in this dataset.

collectionCode.description: Collection code identifying observation records, uniformly labeled Observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each species occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: Empty field with no recorded values for species occurrence records.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals or organizations responsible for identifying the species occurrence records.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of Rusa timorensis occurrence records, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

license.description: Creative Commons license for species occurrence data.

rightsHolder.description: Individuals or organizations holding rights to species occurrence records.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals or organizations who recorded the species occurrence data.

typeStatus.description: Type status field entirely empty in dataset.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent data interpretation or processing event.

mediaType.description: Media type of observation records, including combinations of still images.

issue.description: Data quality flags for species occurrence records, including coordinate and taxon issues.
